meta.subject: hardware: fix bug where l2a_is_restarted_flush could be incorrect

en.summary: Fixes stale flush-restart tracking in the L2 arbiter so a new flush request is not mistaken for a restarted flush.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a race where a first-pass flush packet could look like a completed restarted flush and silently fail.
The patch changes hardware/core/l2_cache_arb.sv, a central L2 request arbiter module.
The fix explicitly clears l2a_is_restarted_flush on ordinary core requests and on idle cycles.
evidence: The only touched file is hardware/core/l2_cache_arb.sv.
Two new assignments set l2a_is_restarted_flush to 0 in the core-request branch and in the no-request branch.
The restarted-request branch already set l2a_is_restarted_flush from is_restarted_flush, so the bug was stale state retention outside that branch.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache arbiter often carries a meta bit that tells downstream logic whether a flush packet is a restarted or replayed flush or a fresh first-pass flush. The old logic failed to clear that bit on ordinary requests or idle cycles, so stale restart metadata could leak into a new flush and make it look like a replayed request.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: flush-restart state tracking in cache request arbitration
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A restarted flush was seen recently, and a new core-originated flush arrives before the restart flag is explicitly cleared.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Leave the restart flag latched across unrelated requests or idle cycles instead of clearing it on non-restarted traffic.
portability_notes: Apply this to any arbiter or pipeline register that tags cache-control requests as restarted or replayed.
The fault is about stale metadata retention, not about the flush opcode itself.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the register or pipeline field that forwards flush requests together with a restarted marker.
Remove the explicit clear of that marker on ordinary core requests and on idle cycles.
Keep the logic that sets the marker on genuine restarted flush traffic unchanged.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds explicit clears of l2a_is_restarted_flush when dispatching a new core request and when there is no request.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete the two clearing assignments to l2a_is_restarted_flush in the core-request branch and in the no-request branch.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A fresh flush can be mistaken for a restarted or completed flush, causing the flush to terminate early or silently miss the intended cache state.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly explains the stale-state race and silent flush failure mode.
The patch adds only clear assignments; no opcode or datapath changes are involved.
The modified module is the L2 arbiter that forwards requests and flush metadata.
notes: This is a classic sticky-control-bit bug.
A reproducer needs at least one prior restarted flush followed by a new ordinary flush.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 仲裁器中的 flush-restart 状态残留问题，避免新的 flush 请求被误认成 restarted flush。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确描述了一个竞争条件：第一次发出的 flush 包可能被看成已经开始处理过的 restarted flush，并且静默失败。
补丁修改的是 hardware/core/l2_cache_arb.sv，这是核心 L2 请求仲裁模块。
修复在普通 core 请求分支和空闲分支上显式清零 l2a_is_restarted_flush。
evidence: 唯一被修改的文件是 hardware/core/l2_cache_arb.sv。
补丁新增了两处 l2a_is_restarted_flush 置 0，分别位于普通 core 请求分支和无请求分支。
restarted 请求分支原本就会根据 is_restarted_flush 设置该位，因此真正的问题是离开该分支后的陈旧状态残留。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 缓存仲裁器通常会带一个元数据位，告诉下游当前 flush 包是 restarted 或 replayed flush，还是新的第一次 flush。旧逻辑在普通请求和空闲周期中没有清除这个标志，导致陈旧 restart 元数据泄漏到新的 flush 上，让它看起来像重放请求。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 请求仲裁中的 flush-restart 状态跟踪
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 设计最近刚看到过一个 restarted flush，而在该标志清零前又到来了一个新的 core 发起 flush。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 不要在无关请求或空闲周期中清除 restart 标志，让它跨周期保留。
portability_notes: 适用于任何会给 cache-control 请求附带 restarted 或 replayed 标记的仲裁器或流水寄存器。
该故障针对的是陈旧元数据残留，而不是 flush opcode 本身。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位转发 flush 请求并携带 restarted 标记的寄存器或流水字段。
删除普通 core 请求分支和空闲分支中对该标记的显式清零。
保留真正 restarted flush 流量设置该标记的逻辑。
不要改动 request-valid 处理。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: l2_cache_arb 中 l2a_is_restarted_flush 的更新逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在派发新的 core 请求和无请求时都显式清零了 l2a_is_restarted_flush。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除普通 core 请求分支和无请求分支里的两处 l2a_is_restarted_flush 清零赋值。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 一个新的 flush 会被误认成 restarted 或已完成的 flush，导致 flush 提前结束或静默失败。
evidence_for_injection: 提交说明明确解释了陈旧状态竞争和静默 flush 失败模式。
补丁只新增了清零赋值，没有改动 opcode 或数据路径。
被修改的模块正是负责转发请求及其 flush 元数据的 L2 仲裁器。
notes: 这是典型的 sticky 控制位 bug。
复现通常需要先发生一次 restarted flush，再发生一次新的普通 flush。
